title: Transport multiple objects of the same type one at a time
description: Use this when a task requires moving two or more objects of the same category to a target location.
content: When moving multiple similar objects, locate all instances first, then carry and place each object individually at the destination. Repeat the go-to-source, take-object, go-to-destination, move-object cycle until the required quantity is delivered.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two alarmclock in desk.

title: Verify object presence before taking
description: Use this when arriving at a location to confirm the target object is actually present before attempting to pick it up.
content: Examine the location's visible object list after arriving; only take an object when it is explicitly listed as present, avoiding wasted actions on locations that do not contain the target.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a pencil in sidetable.

title: Place cooled objects into target appliances after cooling
description: Use this when a task requires both cooling an object and placing it into a specific appliance.
content: After cooling an object with a fridge, carry it to the target appliance (e.g., coffeemachine) and place it inside to complete the task.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Clean objects at a sinkbasin
description: Use this when a task requires cleaning an object such as an egg.
content: After picking up the object, go to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with the sinkbasin to clean the object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in fridge.
